# Lada N — Massage & Beauty Studio

> Massage, hair removal, permanent makeup and beauty services in central Kyiv, Ukraine. One studio at 10 Mala Zhytomyrska St., a few minutes' walk from Maidan Nezalezhnosti. Appointment by phone only — there is no online booking.

The studio belongs to Lada Novikova, its founder: a physical rehabilitation specialist by training (National University of Ukraine on Physical Education and Sport) who gives massage sessions herself. The rest of the team works under the studio's name.

The site is static HTML in three languages: Ukrainian at the root, Russian under `/ru/`, English under `/en/`. The home page and the service category pages exist in all three languages; service subpages, the knowledge base and the expert page exist in Ukrainian and Russian only. The address of a page is identical in every language it exists in, and the home page and every service page carry their price list in the served HTML — no script has to run to see a price.

## Pages

Ukrainian (default):

- [Home](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/): studio, services overview, full price list
- [Massage](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/massage/): full body, local and exotic massage
- [Hair removal](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/depilation/): waxing and sugaring, women and men
  - [Sugaring](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/depilation/sugaring/): sugar paste hair removal, women's and men's zones and combos
- [Permanent makeup](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/permanent/): brows, lips, eyeliner
  - [Brow permanent makeup](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/permanent/brows/): powder brows, correction and cover-up of old permanent makeup
- [Brows, lashes and makeup](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/beauty/): brow and lash treatments, makeup, hair styling

Russian: [/ru/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/), [/ru/massage/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/massage/), [/ru/depilation/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/depilation/), [/ru/depilation/sugaring/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/depilation/sugaring/), [/ru/permanent/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/permanent/), [/ru/permanent/brows/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/permanent/brows/), [/ru/beauty/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/beauty/)

English: [/en/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/), [/en/massage/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/massage/), [/en/depilation/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/depilation/), [/en/permanent/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/permanent/), [/en/beauty/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/beauty/)

## Knowledge base

Articles that answer one question each about the studio's services, in Ukrainian and Russian. There is no section root: `/guide/` answers 404.

- [Hair removal: questions and answers](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/depilation/): hair removal hub, lists its articles (Ukrainian)
- [Depilation or epilation](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/depilation/vs-epilation/): how depilation differs from epilation, which methods belong to each and how long results last (Ukrainian)
- [What not to do after hair removal](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/depilation/aftercare/): how long to skip saunas, sun, workouts and scrubs after waxing or sugaring, ingrown hairs and when to see a doctor (Ukrainian)
- [Waxing or sugaring: which is better](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/depilation/vs-sugaring/): what wax and sugar paste have in common and how they differ for skin, hair, sensation and results (Ukrainian)
- [What sugaring is](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/depilation/what-is-sugaring/): what the paste is made of, how the procedure goes, how it differs from wax and how long it lasts (Ukrainian)
- [Hair removal: questions and answers](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/guide/depilation/): the same hub in Russian
- [Depilation or epilation](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/guide/depilation/vs-epilation/): the same article in Russian
- [Waxing or sugaring: which is better](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/guide/depilation/vs-sugaring/): the same article in Russian
- [Permanent makeup: questions and answers](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/permanent/): permanent makeup hub, lists its articles (Ukrainian)
- [How long permanent makeup lasts](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/permanent/how-long/): how long brow and lip permanent makeup lasts, why the pigment fades and when correction and refresh are needed (Ukrainian)
- [Brow permanent makeup aftercare](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/permanent/aftercare/): how brows heal after permanent makeup, what to apply, and when water, makeup and saunas are fine again (Ukrainian)
- [Who should not get permanent makeup](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/permanent/contraindications/): skin conditions, keloids, bleeding disorders, diabetes, pregnancy and cold sores, and who the studio does not do brow permanent makeup for (Ukrainian)
- [Permanent makeup and tattooing: the difference](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/permanent/vs-tattoo/): whether "tatuazh" and permanent makeup are the same, how deep the pigment goes, how it fades and how it is removed (Ukrainian)
- [How long lips take to heal after permanent makeup](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/permanent/lips-healing/): swelling and crusts in the first days, when the final colour shows, cold sores and correction (Ukrainian)
- [Is brow permanent makeup harmful](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/guide/permanent/harm/): which complications happen and how often, pigments, MRI and removal (Ukrainian)
- [Permanent makeup: questions and answers](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/guide/permanent/): the same hub in Russian
- [Who should not get permanent makeup](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/guide/permanent/contraindications/): the same article in Russian
- [Permanent makeup and tattooing: the difference](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/guide/permanent/vs-tattoo/): the same article in Russian
- [What permanent makeup is, in plain words](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/guide/permanent/what-is/): how the pigment gets into the skin, which areas are done, how the procedure and healing go and how long it lasts (Russian)
- [Lada Novikova](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/lada/): the founder who signs the knowledge base articles, with the list of them (Ukrainian)
- [Lada Novikova](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/lada/): the same page in Russian

## Services

- **Massage**: relaxation, therapeutic, author's, sports and four-hands sessions; local work on the neck, back, face, head, feet and hands; exotic techniques — Gua Sha, coconut bowls, anti-cellulite, cupping with stone therapy, Yumeiho, Tibetan honey and chocolate, Abhyanga, Shirodhara, lymphatic drainage
- **Hair removal**: waxing and sugaring (sugar paste), women and men, single zones and combos
- **Permanent makeup**: brows, lips, interlash and eyeliner; a correction 28–60 days after the procedure costs 50% of it; a refresh within 6 months costs 80%
- **Brows, lashes and makeup**: brow shaping and tinting, lash extensions and lamination, makeup, hair styling

Session prices are stated on the home page and on every service page in Ukrainian hryvnia; the knowledge base and the expert page carry no prices. Duration-based services list a price per duration; a correction is priced as a share of the base procedure and has no fixed amount.

## Machine-readable

- [Sitemap](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/sitemap-index.xml): all pages with their language alternates
- [robots.txt](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/robots.txt)

Every page carries JSON-LD: the home page describes the business (address, hours, phone, price range, founder), each category page and service subpage describes the service with its offers and a breadcrumb. A knowledge base article is an `Article` whose author is the founder, with a breadcrumb; a knowledge base hub is a `CollectionPage` with a breadcrumb; the expert page is a `ProfilePage` about the founder. Share-priced items are deliberately absent from the offer list — an offer without an amount would read as a free service.
